title: Handling panels for an exhibit
passage: For Thursday's exhibit pickup, take only panels with a number on the back. A title on the front doesn't show they're ready; some were printed early. Use the level path through the side gate. Lift from the bottom; the handle is just for turning the panel upright. In the hall, lean the panels against the padded wall. Keep them wrapped until the display team arrives.
passageZh: 星期四領取展板時，只取背面有編號的展板。正面有標題不代表已備妥，有些標題提早印了。請走側門那條平坦的路。搬運時從底部抬起；把手只用來將展板轉至直立。到大廳後，將展板靠在有防撞墊的牆上。展出小組到場前，不要拆開包裝。
